title: schnorr48 stub abort()s on attacker-controlled RF input when CONFIG_LICHEN_LINK_SCHNORR=n
description: PRE-EXISTING, found during jfln review. With CONFIG_LICHEN_LINK=y and CONFIG_LICHEN_LINK_SCHNORR=n (only way to get link layer without LICHEN_CRYPTO_MONOCYPHER; SCHNORR selects it), a frame carrying S/SI bits whose SIID matches a pinned peer reaches schnorr48_verify_frame -> schnorr48_stub_abort() (lichen/subsys/lichen/crypto/schnorr48.c:231-235,565,583) -> abort(): attacker-controllable crash. Wrong failure mode for untrusted input; the stub should return -EAUTH or -ENOSYS. Note the wave's SIID pre-filter narrowed this (unknown SIIDs reject before the stub), but pinned-SIID frames still abort.
